request_framing: one UTF-8 JSON object per physical line; one response per request; flush after every response
result_encoding: response preserves request id; success has ok:true; query returns columns and rows; writes return affected_rows
error_encoding: ok:false with non-empty error.code and error.message
mode_encoding: execute request mode exact or ann; ann may safely fall back to exact
distance_output: Euclidean L2 distance over stored float32 values
transaction_error_rule: failed statement has no partial effect; uncommitted writes are rolled back on shutdown
data_dir_contract: persistent files under /data; restart reuses the directory
